title: Coast Guard Responds to 60-foot Vessel on Fire
description: B-roll of the U.S. Coast Guard responding to a 60-foot vessel that is on fire. Scenes include footage of the vessel on fire, the crew in a life raft and Coast Guardsmen rescuing the crew. Video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Kelly Parker. Produced by PADET Astoria, Oregon.
